title: Global strong solutions to the aligned 2.5D non-resistive full MHD system with high temperature and a strong magnetic field
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for an aligned vertical-field reduction of the full compressible non-resistive MHD equations in two space variables. The shear and bulk viscosities are proportional to $θ^α$, and the heat conductivity is proportional to $θ^β$. For $2<α<β<α+2$, we prove global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions when the background temperature and the comparable magnetic background are sufficiently large, while the positive density background is fixed.
